line: Crowley's Nine of Wands is the card for the second decan of Sagittarius, with the Moon as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Sagittarius.

quotes.quote: The Nine of Wands is called Strength
This card is also governed by the Moon in Sagittarius

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: The Nine represents always the fullest development of the Force
